warnings.title: Nylon Material Reminder
warnings.message:
You are printing with Nylon. Important reminders:

• Dry filament for 6-8 hours at 70-80°C before use
• Use an enclosed chamber (60°C recommended)
• Apply strong bed adhesion (glue stick on PEI)
• Nylon is highly hygroscopic - keep it sealed when not in use

Proceed with slicing?
